comment: Options menu, bind keys, key first, twice in one visit to the "Do what?" menu: '{' to toggle(autopickup) through Snprintf() (cmd.c line 2376), then '}' to pray through Strcat() (line 2379), which appends to whatever the parameter bind left in the reused stack slot. Seed, character and inputs chosen independently. Recorded on macOS by .github/workflows/macos-recorder.yml to measure what the judge's build does with a Strcat() bind after a Snprintf() one (docs/testing.md, "The key-binding difference").
